verdict.rationale: Fedora's own docs claim one-click installs from Fedora repos, Flathub, or elsewhere (fedora-docs-8, fedora-docs-12), which aligns with GNOME Software's access to thousands of apps, but a hands-on community report describes a concrete failure of this exact promise—needing many manual commands to install common apps like Discord/Spotify, apps not running correctly, and GUI apps not appearing in the menu (fedora-comm-15). This is a specific counter-example to the 'easy install' claim, not just general skepticism. missing for 10: independent verification of catalog breadth/thousands of apps, corroboration that GNOME Software one-click install works smoothly across common apps, resolution of the comm-15 failure report.
